scientific_integrity: The homotopy proof uses an exhaustive exact acyclic face-poset matching, independently verified from the graph and face definitions. Character values are obtained by signed chain traces and Lefschetz theory. No independent external audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the 3-by-4 Cartesian grid at robust parameter four; a general width theorem and integral decomposition of the rectangle-symmetry representation are not claimed.
title: A wedge of \(20\) five-spheres and reflection characters for the four-robust \(3\times4\) grid
